reason: Self-contained change to the Notifications module's navbar UI/JS with a minor breaking change to the public JS initializeContainer signature (new parameter inserted before wrapperSelector) that could silently break any theme/custom JS calling it with the old two-argument order, but core usages are updated and impact is isolated to notification badge display.
